name: mcp
description: Self-hosted MCP servers (JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio): fetch (URL to markdown), sqlite (read-only query/schema), and time (timezone conversion)

capabilities.name: mcp.fetch
capabilities.description: Fetch a URL and return content as markdown or raw text with HTML conversion, encoding detection, and pagination safety (fetch_mcp.py; serve via 'python -m modules.mcp.fetch_mcp serve')

capabilities.name: mcp.sqlite
capabilities.description: Read-only SQLite query, list_tables, get_schema, and optional writable execute with parameterized queries (sqlite_mcp.py; serve via 'python -m modules.mcp.sqlite_mcp serve')

capabilities.name: mcp.time
capabilities.description: Get current time in a timezone and convert times between timezones with DST gap/fold handling (time_mcp.py; serve via 'python -m modules.mcp.time_mcp serve')

health_checks.description: Verify all three MCP server modules import

storage.description: Default SQLite database for sqlite_mcp (DEFAULT_DB_PATH); created and managed by callers
